input.creator_request: Use the voice from the talk to camera video and split around the video behind a fast pace montage of the remaining videos. Show them chronologically.

speech_clips.summary: Creator talking to camera introducing the games

segments.text: Okay, hello world. First of all, thank you to everyone who has ever taken part in the Olympics.
Now we are international, across the pond, the London edition, hosted right here in Wimbledon.
The first one was the London 2012 tennis, but this is a one of a kind event.
Three sports as usual, and as usual the rules are made up by me on the spot.
The first sport is a relay around the park, and everyone has to carry something ridiculous.
The second sport is a trivia round, and the loser buys the next round of drinks.
The last sport is the big final on the tennis court, winner takes the golden trophy.
Let us get started, and may the best person win. Good luck everybody!
